name: mbx-flow
description: MBX Flow publishes to your social accounts: Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, Slack, Discord and more. Connect it and ask in plain words: ChatGPT sees your connected accounts and your queue, writes drafts, schedules posts at least 10 minutes ahead, finds free stock photos, and gives you a link to add your own photos from your phone. Nothing is published right away and nothing is deleted: every post waits in your MBX Flow queue, where you can change or cancel it.

publication.release_notes:
The previous review reported that the sign-in / OAuth flow could not be completed. We identified an issue that could leave the sign-in page stuck on "Please wait" after valid credentials were entered, preventing reviewers from reaching the authorization screen and returning to ChatGPT.

We fixed this issue in production in MBX Flow 1.29.33, deployed on October 10, 2026. We tested the complete connection flow from ChatGPT: sign in, select "Allow," and return to ChatGPT connected.

defaultPrompt: Show me the posts scheduled for this week
Write a post about my new release and save it as a draft
Schedule a post for Friday at 6 pm with a stock photo

negative.description: Immediate publication is outside this connector. Explain that it can save drafts or schedule at least ten minutes ahead. Do not invoke schedule_post or create_draft as a substitute without user authorization, and do not claim publication.
negative.prompt: Publish Hello from MBX Flow review to my connected accounts right now.

negative.description: Deleting posts is outside this connector. Explain the limitation and direct the user to manage posts in MBX Flow. Do not call write tools or claim any post was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete every post in my MBX Flow workspace permanently.

negative.description: Connecting new social accounts is outside this connector. Explain that account authorization must be completed in the MBX Flow app. Do not request social network passwords, invoke posting tools or claim an account was connected.
negative.prompt: Connect a new Instagram account to my MBX Flow workspace for me.

positive.prompt: What workspace and plan am I connected to, and which social accounts are connected?
positive.description: Show the authenticated workspace, plan and real connected social accounts. An empty account list must be reported accurately.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_workspace and list_accounts. Describe the returned workspace, plan and connected account names and networks; do not invent accounts or expose credentials.

positive.prompt: Create a draft saying Hello from MBX Flow review. Do not publish or schedule it. Then show me the saved post.
positive.description: Create a review draft and retrieve it. This case must not schedule or publish anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_draft with text Hello from MBX Flow review, then get_post with the returned post ID. Confirm matching text and draft status, with no scheduled publication time. Do not call schedule_post.

positive.prompt: Schedule Hello from MBX Flow review to a connected test account for tomorrow at 10am America/New_York, then show my scheduled queue.
positive.description: Requires at least one connected publishable test account. Ask the reviewer to choose the account if several are available. This case intentionally schedules a future test post.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a real test account ID using list_accounts, asking for a choice if ambiguous. Call schedule_post with the selected accountIds and a valid ISO 8601 timestamp for tomorrow at 10am America/New_York, at least ten minutes ahead. Call list_posts with status scheduled and confirm the returned post is scheduled at that time. Do not claim it has already published.

positive.prompt: Find free stock photos of a sunrise over mountains.
positive.description: Search the configured stock photo source using a natural language subject. The reviewer workspace must have stock photos available.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_photos with a query describing sunrise over mountains. Show only returned photos with usable image links and photographer credits. If no results are returned, report that accurately; never invent photos.

positive.prompt: Create a draft saying My review photo, then give me a link to add my own photo to that draft. Do not schedule or publish it.
positive.description: Create a new draft fixture and request its own-photo upload link. This case does not upload or publish a photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_draft with text My review photo, then get_photo_upload_link with postId equal to the returned draft ID. Return the provided URL and expiry. Explain that the user opens the link to upload; do not claim a file has been uploaded or call schedule_post.
